description: REQ-002 requires period construction to fail when no valid instant is found within 180 minutes but defines no HTTP status/body, envelope presence, or UI state for that failure. This permits the authenticated endpoint to return a 500, synthesize a period, or mislabel the organ as insufficient_data, none of which is binary-gradable against the otherwise closed failure contract.

evidence.snippet: Fail period construction rather than guessing if no matching/next valid instant exists within 180 minutes.
